Name: SFG's Farmer Age Dialogue Tweaks (Content Patcher)
Author: ShotFromGuns
Description:
[size=5]New in 1.2.1[/size]

Yet more lines have been added from a few more random files. An error in Lewis's Egg Festival dialogue (the wrong line got replaced) has also been fixed.

[size=5]About[/size]

Are you sick of everybody treating your farmer like they're in their late teens or early 20s? This Content Patcher pack allows you to pick from several age ranges:

[list]
[*][b]MiddleAge:[/b] Characters will speak to your farmer like they're a mature adult.
[*][b]Old:[/b] Characters will speak to your farmer like they're around the same age as Evelyn, George, and Linus.
[*][b]Ancient:[/b] Characters will speak to your farmer like they're hundreds (if not thousands) of years old.
[*][b]Immortal:[/b] Characters will speak to your farmer like they'll be living indefinitely.
[*][b]Off:[/b] The mod will not do anything to the game's dialogue. It works exactly as if you didn't have the mod installed.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b][/url].
[*][b]Download[/b] this mod, and [b]unzip[/b] it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Optional: Gender-Neutral Variant[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Download the optional [b]content.json[/b] file.
[*][b]After installing[/b] the main mod, [b]replace[/b] the original content.json with the new one.
[*][b]Confirm[/b] anything that tells you the file is about to be overwritten.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Customize[/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Run the game using SMAPI[/b] at least once to generate a [b]config.json[/b] file.
[*]With the game closed, [b]open config.json[/b] in a simple text editor.
[*]Change the value from the default to whichever version you want ([b]MiddleAge[/b], [b]Old[/b], [b]Ancient[/b], or [b]Immortal[/b]; or leave it [b]Off[/b] if you don't want the mod to do anything at all)
[*][b]Save your changes[/b] to the config.json file.
[*][b]Run the game using SMAPI[/b], and you should start seeing dialogue that reflects your chosen age.
[/list]
Repeat steps 2–5 anytime you want to make a change.

[size=5]How to Uninstall[/size]

Delete the mod's folder from [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].

(If you want to temporarily disable the mod without completely uninstalling it, you could instead set it to [b]Off[/b].)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

This mod should have zero compatibility issues, except with other mods that change these particular lines of dialogue. If two or more mods change the same line, Content Patcher will pick one and apply it (typically the one from the pack that was loaded last, which is usually the one that comes last alphabetically).

To actively control which mod's line is chosen:

[list=1]
[*]With Stardew Valley closed, open each relevant mod's [b]content.json[/b] file.
[*]Find the relevant line.
[*]In that line's [font=Courier New]"Action"[/font] block, look for [font=Courier New]"Enabled": "true"[/font] (add it if it doesn't exist).
[*][b]Leave[/b] the value as [font=Courier New]"true"[/font] for the mod you want to use for that line, and [b]change[/b] it to [font=Courier New]"false"[/font] for the rest.
[*][b]Save[/b] the content.json files, and you should see only the chosen line the next time you run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
